title: Copilot Studio: cost visibility in Preview chat and History
summary: Hold: the briefing overstates environment allocations as a cap on spending, although linked pay-as-you-go billing can continue after prepaid credits run out. The allocation API example lacks its required request body, and the allocation UI path omits a documented navigation heading.

claims.claim: The planned change gives makers consumption-cost visibility in Preview and agent history for testing and historical runs.
claims.quote: Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within preview tab and agent history for their preview/testing usage as well as all every historical run.

claims.where: What's changing; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap description does not specify which agent harness or kinds of agent it covers.
claims.quote: Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: For Microsoft Copilot harness agents, Preview chat shows a running total of estimated Copilot Credits for the current test session.
claims.quote: The Preview chat shows a running total of estimated Copilot Credits used during the current test session. It updates as you interact with the agent.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Preview > History shows a Credits used column containing estimated credits for past test conversations.
claims.quote: Select History in the preview header to open the history view. ... Credits used | The estimated Copilot Credits used during the session.

claims.claim: Learn does not identify these documented credit displays as the shipped implementation of roadmap item 571194.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio cost visibility Preview History roadmap 571194 licensing price rollout default switch Power Platform API. Opened preview-overview, preview-history, billing-credit-understand-display and billing-credit-overview; none identifies item 571194.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Preview and Evaluate credit estimates are near-real-time approximations.
claims.quote: The estimates in Preview and Evaluate are near-real-time approximations that give you immediate visibility into how many credits an action is likely to consume

claims.claim: Monitor is updated a few times daily and shows accurate consumption for processed events.
claims.quote: The view in Monitor is updated a few times a day and shows the accurate number of credits consumed for all events processed up to that point.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Monitor is the final billed-credit figure and source of truth for the period.
claims.quote: the number might not reflect the entire bill until all activities for the selected period are processed. Once processing is complete, these values are the authoritative measure of credits consumed.
claims.fix: Qualify the final-figure statement with: 'Monitor becomes authoritative for the selected period once all its activities have been processed; before then it might not reflect the entire bill.'

claims.claim: The final accurate number appears in Monitor within a few hours.
claims.quote: Those events are then processed, and the final, accurate number is reflected in Monitor within a few hours.

claims.where: Why it matters; Cost and licensing; front matter: licensing.notes; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness billing starts while building, and previewing, testing and evaluations consume Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: the Microsoft Copilot harness charges credits from the moment you start building. Experiences such as creating an automated solution with natural language, previewing and testing an agent, and generating and creating agent evaluations all consume credits.

claims.claim: The credit display helps makers compare the consumption effects of prompts, knowledge sources and tools before publication.
claims.quote: This feature helps you understand how different prompts, instructions, knowledge sources, and tools affect consumption before you publish your agent.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap item's default is not stated, and no display-specific admin or maker switch is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio "credit" "display" "disable" "Preview"; Copilot Studio cost visibility Preview History roadmap 571194 licensing price rollout default switch Power Platform API. Read roadmap, preview-overview, preview-history, billing-credit-understand-display and cost-management pages.

claims.claim: The credit display reports estimated usage rather than enforcing a spending limit.
claims.quote: Whenever a credit value is an estimate, the user interface includes an information icon and an explanatory message indicating that the value is intended for planning purposes and will be finalized later.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; controls[0].note; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Environment credit allocations cap credit spending.
claims.quote: An allocation isn't a boundary if the environment can continue drawing from tenant capacity or pay-as-you-go billing. ... This setting doesn't prevent consumption through a pay-as-you-go billing plan linked to the environment.
claims.fix: Replace the cap claim and row note with: 'Environment allocations govern prepaid capacity. To contain prepaid consumption, clear Draw from the available capacity in my tenant; usage can still continue through a linked pay-as-you-go billing plan.' In the summary replace 'how many credits each environment can spend' with 'each environment's prepaid credit allocation'. Keep this qualification wherever allocations are described as controlling spend.

claims.claim: When an environment has no available credits, credit-dependent experiences can stop for makers and end users.
claims.quote: When an environment has no available Copilot Credits, experiences that require credits can stop working. This limitation can affect both makers and end users.

claims.claim: History shows credit figures alongside existing status, duration and steps information.
claims.quote: Status | The outcome ... Steps/Turns | The number of processing steps and conversation turns ... Duration | How long the conversation lasted ... Credits used | The estimated Copilot Credits used during the session.

claims.claim: The credit-display documentation describes no new data source accessed by the agent.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio preview chat History credit display estimated usage admin switch default visibility licensing. Read preview-overview, preview-history and billing-credit-understand-display; these describe runtime consumption estimates, not a new agent data source.

claims.claim: History conversation details include the full message transcript.
claims.quote: In the history view, select a conversation to open its details. Review the full message history, including user messages and agent responses.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Credits are charged to the environment where the agent runs rather than the individual maker or user.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are charged to the environment where the agent runs, from prepaid capacity or through the environment's pay-as-you-go billing plan, and not to the individual makers or users who run agents.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: The documentation does not specify which other makers can see a maker's History credit figures.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio Preview History Credits used visibility permissions other makers conversation history. Read preview-history and preview-overview; neither specifies cross-maker visibility of History credit figures.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes a display change for makers rather than a change to agent actions.
claims.quote: Makers can see the costs as they test, iterate, and review conversations, making usage costs transparent throughout the development experience.

claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness consumption is not included with the user's Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
claims.quote: This usage isn't included with a user's Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: licensing.notes
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness agents are billed for all usage regardless of the user's licence.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot harness agents | No | Billed for all usage. Creation and runtime activities consume Copilot Credits regardless of the user's license.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Environment consumption draws on prepaid capacity or the environment's pay-as-you-go billing plan.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are charged to the environment where the agent runs, from prepaid capacity or through the environment's pay-as-you-go billing plan

claims.claim: Developer and trial environments move to usage-based billing on 1 September 2026.
claims.quote: Developer environments and trial environments move to usage-based billing September 1, 2026.

claims.claim: The Preview and History documentation concerns Microsoft Copilot harness agents, and History lists such an agent as a prerequisite.
claims.quote: The Preview tab in agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness in Microsoft Copilot Studio maintains a history of your test conversations. ... Prerequisites ... An agent created with the Microsoft Copilot harness

claims.claim: Learn does not specify a rollout mechanism, release channel or licence prerequisite for roadmap item 571194 itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio cost visibility Preview History roadmap 571194 licensing price rollout default switch Power Platform API. Read preview-overview, preview-history and billing-credit-understand-display; none identifies item 571194 or gives item-specific rollout or licensing prerequisites.

claims.claim: Allocation management requires Power Platform Administrator, Global Administrator or an equivalent role able to manage licensing and capacity.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: The Harness column under Power Platform admin center > Manage > Copilot Studio identifies the harness used by agents.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage > Copilot Studio. Filter the Harness column to GitHub Copilot. The column shows which harness each agent is built with: GitHub Copilot, Standard, or Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: The cited allocation UI path is Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Licensing. Under Products, select Copilot Studio, and then select Manage Copilot Credits. ... Under Allocate capacity ... Under Capacity overages, select or clear Draw from the available capacity in my tenant
claims.fix: Replace the structured and rendered path with 'Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment'. The cited page explicitly names the Products heading. When giving the draw-setting location, use 'Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant'.

claims.claim: The printed PUT call with prose about MCSMessages and a TenantPool rule is a complete allocation operation.
claims.quote: scope = @{ environmentId = $environmentId } ... entitlementId = "MCSMessages" ... allocation = @{ quantity = 5000 } ... @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false } ... -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json" -Body $allocationBody
claims.fix: The endpoint and version exist; the pre-check's literal-string warning is not an endpoint error. Replace the prose call with 'PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01' and explicitly include Authorization: Bearer <access-token>, Content-Type: application/json, and body {"scope":{"environmentId":"<environment-id>"},"allocatedEntitlements":[{"entitlementId":"MCSMessages","allocation":{"quantity":<credit-quantity>},"enforcementRules":[{"ruleType":"TenantPool","enabled":false}]}]}. Identify this as allocating prepaid credits and disabling tenant-pool draw, not stopping linked pay-as-you-go consumption. Use the same complete request in the rendered table.

claims.claim: Agent monthly limits are configured at Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Copilot Studio > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit.
claims.quote: In the Power Platform admin center, go to Licensing > Copilot Studio. Select Manage Agents. Select the agent, and then select Set limit.

claims.claim: The agent monthly-limit interface supports a notification threshold.
claims.quote: Enter the monthly Copilot Credit limit. Configure the notification threshold.

claims.claim: The monthly-limit interface offers a Stop usage option.
claims.quote: Turn on Stop usage if the agent should be turned off when it reaches the limit.

claims.claim: A published environment-group rule governing tenant-pool draw prevents environment-level UI or API overrides, returning TenantPoolLockedByPolicy.
claims.quote: If a published environment group rule governs Draw from the available capacity in my tenant, you can't override the setting for an individual environment. Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the TenantPoolLockedByPolicy error.

claims.claim: The consumption licensing model describes the documented Microsoft Copilot harness usage discussed in the briefing.
claims.quote: Agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness use consumption-based billing. Building, testing, evaluating, and running these agents can consume Copilot Credits.

claims.claim: Variable cost is supported by the Copilot Credits consumption meter for Microsoft Copilot harness testing.
claims.quote: Usage is billed based on consumption and measured in Copilot Credits. ... previewing and testing an agent, and generating and creating agent evaluations all consume credits.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist's instruction to take stock of agents through the Harness inventory has a corresponding controls-table row.
claims.quote: Identify which environments host agents powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness, using the Harness column ... (Manage > Copilot Studio) ... Table contains only 'Prepaid Copilot Credits allocated to an environment, and whether it can draw on tenant capacity'.
claims.fix: The Before rollout inventory step has no table row. To correct without adding a control row, replace that bullet with 'Identify who builds Microsoft Copilot harness agents in each affected environment.'

claims.claim: Administrators control who may build agents through authoring and environment permissions.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot harness doesn't have its own maker-access setting. To control who can create agents, use your existing Copilot Studio and environment permissions.
